53/G.goal: Explain how to optimize VR navigation for the Majuli tour using optimal-path and time-constrained routing and TSP or VRPP solvers to limit cybersickness.
53/G.achieves: It gives the learner a practical understanding of UX optimization in XR and prepares them to move to resource optimization while implementing an XR system with confidence.

53/O1.goal: Explain how to optimize navigation in the Majuli VR tour using optimal-path and time-constrained routing and TSP or VRPP solvers to limit cybersickness.
53/O1.achieves: It lets the learner connect route design to cybersickness reduction in the Majuli case study, supporting the course aim of implementing an XR system with confidence.
